newsitem.title: USA: FIND/SVP sees losses in 1997 first half.
newsitem.headline: FIND/SVP sees losses in 1997 first half.

text.p: Research and consulting company FIND/SVP Inc said Monday it expected a loss for the 1997 first half and a return to profitability in the fourth quarter.
The company also said it expects to report a net loss for the year 1996 on revenues of $30 million.
It said revenues would rise to $35 million for 1997.
It blamed the expected 1997 first half loss on its investment plans.
FIND/SVP obtained $5 million in financing at the end of last year for its restructuring plans, designed to increase growth by 20 percent a year.
The company said it would release 1996 results in mid-March.
